[NMET.6.2] **The callback runs on the caller's stack.** Each
emission happens synchronously, on the stack of the
`ds_engine_*` call that caused it (a pump, an assert, a clock
set), as every callback does ([NCBK.1.7]). The callback must
not block. A call it makes
into the engine that invoked it is refused with
`DS_ERR_STATE` ([RARC.13.16]).
